license_review.policy_finding: CC BY 4.0 is the default for datasets produced by the World Bank and distributed as open data; the catalog also describes ODbL, externally licensed, custom-license, and restricted microdata cases.
attribution_requirements: Do not imply the World Bank endorses the use.
license_review.unresolved_rights: Indicator metadata lists external statistical organizations and national providers, but the API does not disclose their individual reuse licenses or establish whether every cited input is covered by the WDI compilation license. Manual rights clearance is required before the proposed batch.
